fair-cool.label: Fair, cool undertone
fair-cool.foundation: Look for shades with pink or neutral bases. Avoid yellow-heavy or orange-toned foundations.
fair-cool.correctors: Light peach corrector for under-eye circles. Green corrector for redness.
techniques: Blend foundation down the neck for a seamless match
Use a light hand with bronzer to avoid warmth clash
Set with a finely milled translucent powder

fair-neutral.label: Fair, neutral undertone
fair-neutral.foundation: Choose shades that balance pink and yellow. Test on jawline in natural light.
fair-neutral.correctors: Peach or bisque corrector for under-eye darkness.
techniques: Your neutral base works with both warm and cool shades
Layer a light cream blush under powder for longevity
Use a damp sponge for the most natural finish
avoid: Foundations that are too pink or too yellow

fair-warm.label: Fair, warm undertone
fair-warm.foundation: Look for shades with golden or peachy bases. Avoid pink-toned foundations.

techniques: Warm-toned bronzer enhances your natural glow beautifully
Apply blush on the apples of cheeks and blend upward
A golden setting spray adds luminosity
avoid: Mauve lipsticks that wash you out

fair-olive.label: Fair, olive undertone

avoid: Pastel lip shades that look grey

tan-cool.label: Tan, cool undertone

Use a deep translucent powder to avoid white cast

tan-olive.label: Tan, olive undertone
